canada.title: Mayor Chow turns down police board seat, shakes up city hall leadership with new councillors for committees
canada.summary: Mayor Olivia Chow shuffled her leadership team at city hall on Thursday, tapping a former Liberal MP to head up the housing committee and her Scarborough deputy as transit chair.

canada.title: Rescued eagle spreads its wings again thanks to some Yukoners
canada.summary: A Yukon man was driving with a friend just outside Beaver Creek earlier this fall when he came upon what he thought was a dead eagle. It was alive, but seriously injured.

canada.title: Former colleges and universities minister refuses to answer OSAP questions
canada.summary: Ontario’s former minister of colleges and universities, who presided over the file for three years until 2024, is refusing to answer questions about a growing Ontario Student Assistance Program scandal.

canada.title: Suspicious fire destroys downtown Moncton apartment building, damages restaurant
canada.summary: RCMP say they’re investigating a suspicious fire that broke out at a four-unit apartment building in downtown Moncton on Thursday morning.

canada.title: N.S. environment minister dodges questions on concerns employees feel muzzled
canada.summary: If Nova Scotia’s environment minister has concerns about staff in his department feeling muzzled or pressured to soften comments on project reviews, he’s not saying.

canada.title: Horizon asks paramedics to staff Miramichi ER
canada.summary: A New Brunswick health authority has recently turned to paramedics to help staff a hospital emergency room in Miramichi.

canada.title: Inuvik man sentenced to over 3 years for impaired driving causing death in 2021 crash
canada.summary: Malcolm Nerysoo, 30, was found guilty earlier this year in connection with a 2021 crash near Inuvik that killed 38-year-old Kristine McLeod.

canada.title: Weight balance, fuel concerns highlighted in report on deadly 2025 Manitoba plane crash
canada.summary: An investigation into a plane crash that killed four in northern Manitoba last year has raised concerns about weight balance and fuel storage on a flight that almost didn't happen.

canada.title: Saskatchewan recovery centre, accused of falsifying records, to be investigated by auditor
canada.summary: NDP health critic Meara Conway says the leaked records make it appear the EHN Willowview Recovery Centre could be falsifying the documents, which she says would be illegal.

canada.title: Blue Bombers fire head coach Mike O'Shea after 12 seasons
canada.summary: The Winnipeg Blue Bombers announced Thursday they have parted ways with longtime head coach Mike O'Shea.

canada.title: Owners of overly tall, million-dollar Saskatoon house win second appeal
canada.summary: The Saskatoon development appeals board approved the second attempt by the owners of the house on University Drive in the Nutana neighbourhood to allow work to continue on the three-storey home.

canada.title: Granby Zoo offers to rehome bat colony living in Quebec long-term care facility
canada.summary: Officials are still figuring out what do with the bats in a long-term care home in Sorel-Tracy, Que., where a rabies-infected bat came into contact with a resident earlier this month. One of the options being considered is transporting the colony to Granby Zoo's bat refuge.

canada.title: Alberta bill would ban some bike lanes, let transportation minister remove others
canada.summary: Alberta’s government is proposing to ban future bike lanes that remove or restrict motor-vehicle traffic and give itself the power to remove some existing bike lanes.

canada.title: Montreal byelections crucial for rebuilding NDP, party leader Avi Lewis says
canada.summary: Avi Lewis said a win in either Montreal byelection would be "incredible" but he sees these contests — and the four others taking place across Canada on Dec. 7 — as a means to continue building up the NDP's support base for the next general election.
canada.outlet: CBC News + CP24 + Global News (CP), CP24

canada.summary: Anthropic's investor documents warn the company needs to increase sales to pay for its data centre leases and infrastructure. At the same time, the company says it needs to plan its data centre investments years in advance, without knowing whether its customers will be there for the long term.
